stock.description: Shun Ho Holdings Limited, an investment holding company founded in 1973 and based in Central, Hong Kong, manages a diverse portfolio of assets. Its core activities include the ownership and operation of hotels, with nine properties offering approximately 2,821 rooms across Hong Kong, mainland China, and the United Kingdom. The company also actively participates in real estate investment and the trading of financial securities. Renamed in July 2016 from its previous identity as Shun Ho Resources Holdings Limited, it operates as a subsidiary of Trillion Resources Limited.
